cases.prompt: Use visual-system for a small representative task within its documented purpose. Supply an offline fixture when supported.
assertions: Define semantic color, typography, spacing, material, depth, figure, and motion tokens before applying them.
Test actual backgrounds, grayscale, reduced motion, long labels, mobile reading, and print appearance.
cases.grader: Inspect actual output and task-specific evidence; no guessed pass.

cases.prompt: Use visual-system with one missing required input or unavailable dependency and a realistic boundary condition.
assertions: Report the actual missing prerequisite without claiming completion.
Preserve source files and do not fabricate missing data.

cases.prompt: Use visual-system with long labels, ambiguous source content, and the applicable user format constraints.
assertions: Use restrained optical depth, coherent lighting, sharp geometry, and context-specific composition.
Preserve exact data, executable syntax, and source provenance.
cases.grader: Inspect rendered output when visual; inspect textual or data output otherwise.
